title: CRDI 2 cotton (Mc Nair 220): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: CRDI 2 cotton: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: CRDI 2 cotton is a cotton variety. About 113 days to harvest, 2.1 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits. Compare it with others.
excerpt: CRDI 2 is a registered cotton variety, also sold or known as Mc Nair 220. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 1994 as NSIC 1994 Ct 05. Cotton Research and Development bred it. It takes about 113 days from sowing to harvest, with 2.12 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Mc Nair 220, this is the same cotton. The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry. Compare it with the others in our [cotton variety finder](/crop-varieties/cotton), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation in the Philippines](/land-preparation/land-preparation-philippines).

items: **Days to harvest:** about 113 days from sowing to harvest.
**Yield:** 2.12 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

CRDI 2 cotton takes about 113 days from sowing to harvest. That is 6.5 days faster than the average of the 7 cotton varieties with a day count, 119.5 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 2.12 t/ha matches the average of its group, 2.15. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.

Where and when to plant CRDI 2 cotton
Cotton needs a long dry spell at boll opening. Pick a variety by lint yield and fiber quality. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng puno](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-puno).

items.q: Is Mc Nair 220 the same as CRDI 2?
items.a: Yes. Mc Nair 220 is another name for CRDI 2, registered as NSIC 1994 Ct 05. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 113 days from sowing to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 2.12 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of CRDI 2?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
